name: Lease abstract
what: A short summary of a lease's key terms: parties, dates, rent, recoveries, options, obligations and unusual clauses.

fields.label: Tenant
fields.definition: The tenant's legal name as it appears in the signature block of the lease, and any trade name it operates under.

fields.label: Landlord
fields.definition: The landlord named in the lease or in the latest assignment of it; compare it with the seller and the owner of record.

fields.label: Guarantor
fields.definition: Who guarantees the tenant's obligations, if anyone, and whether the guaranty is limited in amount or time; null when there is none.

fields.label: Premises
fields.definition: The suite or building leased and any exclusive yard, parking or storage areas, as the lease and its exhibits describe them.

fields.label: Rentable area
fields.definition: The square feet the lease charges rent on, and the share of the building used for recoveries if the lease states a different figure.

fields.label: Commencement
fields.definition: The date the current term began, taken from the lease or a signed commencement memorandum rather than the rent roll.

fields.label: Expiration
fields.definition: The last day of the current term, after every amendment that extended or shortened it.

fields.label: Earliest exit
fields.definition: The first date the tenant could stop paying rent under the lease, counting termination or kick-out rights and their notice periods; equals the expiration when the tenant has no early exit.

fields.label: Base rent schedule
fields.definition: Each rent period with its start date, monthly rent and annual rent per square foot, including fixed steps, index adjustments with their base month, floor and cap, and any free-rent months.

fields.label: Expense recovery structure
fields.definition: How operating expenses are shared: gross, modified gross, base year, expense stop or triple net, read from the lease's expense clause rather than its title.

fields.label: Who pays each expense
fields.definition: For taxes, insurance, common area costs, utilities, roof and structure, building systems, management and capital replacements: who pays, and any stop, base year, cap or exclusion that limits the tenant's share.

fields.label: Security deposit
fields.definition: The deposit or letter of credit the lease requires, and any terms for reducing or returning it before the end of the term.

fields.label: Landlord obligations still owed
fields.definition: Free rent, improvement allowances, landlord work or commissions the lease promises that are not yet paid or done, with the amount and when each is due.

fields.label: Options and rights
fields.definition: Each renewal, expansion, contraction, termination, purchase, first refusal or first offer right: who holds it, the notice window, and how rent or price is set when it is used.

fields.label: Assignment and use
fields.definition: Whether the tenant may assign or sublet and on what consent standard, the permitted use, any exclusive or go-dark right, and whether the original tenant stays liable after an assignment.

fields.label: Unusual clauses
fields.definition: Anything outside the ordinary run of the lease that could change income or value, such as co-tenancy, relocation, radius, casualty or condemnation terms, with the section number for each.
